notes: Every team skill. status: local (one PM) > candidate (proposed, needs rubric + tests) > stable (ships in plugin) > deprecated. track = which v1 track it belongs to.

skills.name: setup
skills.does: Connects and verifies every tool, links goals sheet and repo, writes profile.

skills.name: capture
skills.does: Turns a lesson from a session into a queue candidate for the reviewer agent.

skills.name: reviewer
skills.does: Maintainer: runs the reviewer pipeline or its eval locally. The reviewer itself lives in reviewer/ and scripts/.

skills.name: veto
skills.does: Files a veto for a wrong context entry as a queue file; applied with no human step.

skills.name: status
skills.does: Shows what happened to the PM's contributions and what is new in the shared context.

skills.name: propose-skill
skills.does: Turns a PM's idea for a skill change into a proposal the skill reviewer can judge.

skills.name: plan-week
skills.does: Monday plan tied to quarterly goals; flags goals with nothing planned.

skills.name: eow-update
skills.does: Friday update against goals with evidence; writes sheet status; sends to head of product after approval.

skills.name: metric
skills.does: Answers metric questions through verified definitions with data traps applied.

skills.name: agent-review
skills.does: Weekly metrics + prompts + transcripts review per agent; generalizes sales-inbound-weekly.

skills.name: triage
skills.does: Freshdesk "waiting on product" queue (Vini Sales and Service) to one evidence-backed case file per ticket: rooftop, 30-day Arali context, code behaviour today, open questions. Read-only.

skills.name: rooftop-brief
skills.does: One-page rooftop brief: account, tickets, calls, agent metrics, decisions.

skills.name: prd
skills.does: Case or idea to approved one-pager and PRD: decide (build, generalise, defer, decline), persona review loops grounded in real customers, fit check against the ask, PM-approved Jira, retro into lessons.

skills.name: prd-to-jira
skills.does: Approved PRD or bug to one Jira issue, created only after the PM picks create.

skills.name: persona-refresh
skills.does: Weekly: last 7 days of Arali conversations across all rooftops to persona observations, watchlists and routed signals, for the reviewer.
